appearance_facts.fact: A single dark-red line connects four circular markers, rising monotonically from the lower-left to the upper-right.
Tick labels read 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020 in left-to-right order.

Horizontal gridlines align with 130, 140, 150, 160, 170; the 2017 marker sits just above the 130 line, the 2018 marker between 140 and 150, the 2019 marker just below 160, and the 2020 marker just above 170.
The visible line spans only 2017 through 2020; no segment or marker is drawn for 2013-2016.

printed_facts.fact: Main heading: 'Respiratory Clinic Visits'; subtitle: 'Reported window shown in the dashboard summary'.
Review scope field: '2013-2020 end-to-end visit trend review'.
Three routing options: 'continued monitoring for a recent upward shift', 'sustained growth follow-up', 'decline-response review'.

public_definitions: Task: 'assign the record to the follow-up pathway that best fits the end-to-end utilization pattern for the full 2013-2020 monitoring window.'

Dashboard instruction: 'Use the displayed yearly visit pattern across the entire review window to determine whether this record should be routed for sustained growth follow-up, continued monitoring of a more recent upswing, or decline-response review.'
uncertain: The chart displays only 2017-2020, so the 2013-2016 portion of the stated 'full 2013-2020' window is not shown and cannot be read.
No data labels or numeric annotations are printed on the markers, so exact visit values are not stated.
It is not specified whether the 'displayed yearly visit pattern' is intended to be treated as the complete review window despite the missing early years.
